scripts.build:ui: bun run --cwd apps/desktop build && bun packages/cli/scripts/embed-ui.ts
scripts.build:binary: bun run build:ui && bun build --compile packages/cli/src/main.ts --outfile dist/dolly
scripts.build:npm: bun run build:ui && bun build --target=bun packages/cli/src/main.ts --outdir packages/cli/dist && bun packages/cli/scripts/pack.ts
scripts.build:core: bun build --target=bun --packages=external packages/core/src/index.ts --outdir packages/core/dist && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && bun packages/core/scripts/pack.ts
